definitions.explanation: Describes a woman who is generous, decisive and protective, and who looks after the people around her like a dependable older sister. A compliment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{姉御肌|あねごはだ}だ。
{姉御肌|あねごはだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{助|たす}けられた→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧。
examples.english: A caring, take-charge senior helped me out.

examples.japanese: {姉御肌|あねごはだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店長|てんちょう}→店長：30461_tenchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: Our big-sisterly store manager always listens when a part-timer is having trouble.

notes:
From {姉御|あねご} (a respected older sister; also the boss's wife among gamblers and gangs) and ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (temperament, type). In {姉御肌|あねごはだ} that overtone has faded.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {姉御肌|あねごはだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧: a big-sisterly woman
- {姉御肌|あねごはだ}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: a take-charge, caring personality
